page.title: Programs
page.label: Our Programs & Activities
page.heroDescription: From weekly community activities to conversations, learning experiences and special events, Girls Unplugged creates different ways for girls to grow together.

programs.title: Community Activities
programs.description: Regular activities that keep the Bloom & Glow Circle connected, engaged and growing throughout the year.

programs.title: Guest Conversations
programs.description: Conversations with guests who bring knowledge, experiences and perspectives that girls can learn from.

programs.title: Learning & Growth
programs.description: Opportunities to explore new ideas, develop useful skills, discover resources and grow personally.

programs.title: Wellness & Sisterhood
programs.description: Spaces that encourage girls to check in with themselves, support one another and build healthier relationships with themselves and others.

programs.title: Special Events
programs.description: Special community moments, themed activities, virtual gatherings and experiences created throughout the year.

programs.title: Girls-Led Spaces
programs.description: Opportunities for girls to contribute ideas, share experiences, lead conversations and help shape the community they belong to.

weeklyRhythm.title: Motivation Monday
weeklyRhythm.description: A little encouragement to help Bloomies start the week with intention and confidence.

weeklyRhythm.title: Wellness Wednesday
weeklyRhythm.description: A chance to pause, check in and talk about wellbeing, self-care and healthy growth.

weeklyRhythm.title: Fun Friday
weeklyRhythm.description: Games, laughter, random conversations and moments to simply enjoy being part of the sisterhood.

weeklyRhythm.title: Reflection Saturday
weeklyRhythm.description: A slower moment to reflect on the week, appreciate your progress and think about what comes next.

guestConversations.title: Learn from people with stories to share.
paragraphs: We create opportunities for girls to hear from people with different experiences, skills and perspectives.
These conversations can cover personal growth, leadership, education, technology, wellbeing, careers, creativity and other topics that matter to girls.
The goal is not simply to listen. It is to leave with something you can think about, try or carry with you.

learningAndGrowth.title: Personal growth
learningAndGrowth.description: Explore confidence, identity, communication, leadership and the everyday process of becoming.

learningAndGrowth.title: Exploring interests
learningAndGrowth.description: Discover ideas, fields, skills and possibilities that may help you understand what you want to explore next.

learningAndGrowth.title: Opportunities
learningAndGrowth.description: We aim to make useful opportunities and resources easier for girls to discover and understand.

learningAndGrowth.title: Using your voice
learningAndGrowth.description: Girls should not only participate in spaces created for them. They should also have opportunities to shape them.

wellnessAndSisterhood.title: Emotional wellbeing
wellnessAndSisterhood.description: We create opportunities for girls to talk, reflect, check in and feel supported.

wellnessAndSisterhood.title: Healthy connection
wellnessAndSisterhood.description: We encourage friendships and conversations rooted in respect, honesty and healthy boundaries.

wellnessAndSisterhood.title: Safe spaces
wellnessAndSisterhood.description: We work to make our community welcoming and respectful, with clear expectations around how we treat one another.

specialEvents.title: Themed Experiences
specialEvents.description: Activities and conversations built around topics that matter to the community.

specialEvents.title: Community Moments
specialEvents.description: Special opportunities to connect beyond our regular weekly activities.

specialEvents.title: Celebrations
specialEvents.description: Moments to celebrate milestones, contributions, growth and the people who make the Circle what it is.

specialEvents.title: New Ideas
specialEvents.description: The community is still growing, so new activities and ideas can emerge from what girls actually need.

howItWorks.title: We Listen
howItWorks.description: We pay attention to the conversations, questions and ideas coming from the community.

howItWorks.title: We Create
howItWorks.description: We turn those ideas into conversations, activities, experiences and opportunities where possible.

howItWorks.title: We Learn
howItWorks.description: We reflect on what works, what can improve and what the community needs next.

howItWorks.title: We Grow Together
howItWorks.description: Girls are not just participants in the Circle. Their experiences help shape what the community becomes.

comingUp.title: This space will keep growing.
comingUp.description: As Girls Unplugged grows, we will continue developing experiences, conversations and opportunities that respond to the community.
comingUp.message: New activities, collaborations, learning experiences and community ideas will be shared here as they become available.
